title: Declare autofill purpose for login form
goal: Use autocomplete to distinguish login ID and active password.
summary: login ID uses the mailbox, but for autofill purposes it is still the username. Active password prompts the browser to use saved credentials.
tasks: Add autocomplete="username" to the account email.
Add autocomplete="current-password" to the current password and retain the control type and label.

example.note: Fill in the existing password on the login page, use current-password. Use new-password only when registering a new account.

hint: type describes the value received by the control, and autocomplete describes the purpose of the field in the form.
